title: Branching model
description: Two long-lived branches: the production branch (main) and the staging branch (develop/base). Both only change through pull requests. Work branches are named develop/<type>/<name>. They start from staging and open their PR into staging, or, with settings.nested_work_branches, start from another work branch (a parent feature branch) and open their PR into that parent. A release is a PR from staging into production.
applies_to: git commit / merge / cherry-pick / revert / am / rebase
gh pr create / gh pr edit --base

rules.name: no-direct-commit-on-protected
rules.title: No direct commits on main or develop/base
rules.description: Commands in 'subcommands' that create commits are blocked while the production or staging branch is checked out. Create a work branch from develop/base instead. 'git merge --ff-only' (syncing with the remote) is allowed. The very first commit of a new repository uses initial_commit_severity.

good: git switch -c develop/feat/login develop/base && git commit -m "feat: add login"
bad: git switch develop/base && git commit -m "feat: add login"

rules.name: no-direct-push-to-protected
rules.title: No direct pushes to main or develop/base
rules.description: git push that updates or deletes the production or staging branch on the remote is blocked; they only change through merged pull requests. --all and --mirror count as touching them. Publishing the branch for the very first time (no remote-tracking ref yet) uses new_branch_severity, so a new repository can be bootstrapped.

rules.name: branch-naming
rules.title: Work branches are named develop/<type>/<name>
rules.description: A new branch (git checkout -b, git switch -c, git branch <name>) must match one of 'patterns' or be the production or staging branch itself.

bad: git switch -c develop/feat/kaneki-harness/p1   (git cannot hold a branch and a folder of the same name; use develop/feat/kh-p1)

rules.name: branch-from-staging
rules.title: Work branches start from develop/base or a parent work branch
rules.description: A new work branch must start from the staging branch (settings.staging_branch, locally or on settings.remote), from one of 'extra_base_refs', or, when settings.nested_work_branches is true, from another work branch (a name matching BR003's patterns, locally or on settings.remote). Pass the start point explicitly (git switch -c develop/feat/x develop/base) or create the branch while it is checked out. Never from the production branch.

rules.name: pr-target
rules.title: PRs target develop/base or a parent work branch; only develop/base releases into main
rules.description: gh pr create must pass --base. Work branches open their PR into the staging branch or, when settings.nested_work_branches is true, into another work branch (their parent feature branch, never themselves). A PR into the production branch must come from the staging branch (a release). gh pr edit --base follows the same rule.

good: gh pr create --base develop/base --title "feat: add login" --body-file pr.md
gh pr create --base main --head develop/base --title "chore(release): v1.2.0" --body-file pr.md
gh pr create --base develop/feat/kaneki-harness --head develop/feat/kh-P1-T07 --title "feat(kaneki): add schemas" --body-file pr.md   (nested_work_branches)
bad: gh pr create --base main --title "feat: add login" --body-file pr.md
